definition_en: A pattern where humans experience discomfort when encountering robots with appearances and movements closely resembling humans but not perfectly aligned, leading to subtle hesitation during physical interactions in shared spaces.

A pattern where individuals gradually reduce vigilance when robots or drones consistently perform tasks accurately, potentially overlooking errors in real-time physical encounters with embodied agents.

A perception where people interpret embodied AI such as robots as having a tangible presence, attributing social awareness to them during close physical proximity and influencing the interaction dynamic.
A pattern where humans instinctively adjust posture or distance when drones or robots enter personal space, mirroring reactions normally directed at fellow humans in crowded environments.
A pattern where observers project human-like emotions and intentions onto wearables or smart-room systems during physical engagement, enhancing the felt sense of companionship in routine use.
A pattern where robots that mimic human gestures during interactions elicit stronger rapport and smoother physical collaborations in shared workspaces.
A pattern where the approach of drones within a few meters heightens arousal and avoidance behaviors, similar to territorial responses observed in natural settings.
A perception where inhabitants feel constant awareness from smart-room actuators adjusting lights or furniture, altering relaxation patterns during daily routines.
A pattern where vibrations or pressures from wearables guide physical movements, fostering intuitive navigation but occasionally causing disorientation in dynamic environments.
A pattern where eye-contact simulation by robots during encounters prompts humans to sustain attention and respond with natural conversational cues.
A pattern where humans calibrate interpersonal distances differently with drones versus robots, treating smaller devices as less invasive in physical vicinities.
A pattern where physical movements of smart-room elements lead observers to ascribe intentional agency, impacting trust in automated environmental controls over time.
A pattern where repeated reliable tactile interactions with wearables build confidence, while inconsistencies erode it during prolonged physical use.
A pattern where rapid advances by robots provoke startle responses, whereas gradual motions facilitate comfortable physical engagements over time.
A pattern where groups of drones maintaining formation during overhead passages evoke awe or unease, influencing pedestrian flow in open areas.
A pattern where continuous physical feedback from wearables leads to sensory habituation, diminishing responsiveness over extended wear periods.
A pattern where predictive adjustments such as door openings create seamless physical flows but can unsettle observers when predictions misalign with intentions.
A pattern where robots aligning body orientations with humans during interactions enhance mutual understanding and collaborative task efficiency.
A pattern where robots emitting unintended heat signatures disrupt personal thermal zones, prompting subconscious distancing in close encounters.
A pattern where directional audio from embodied AI directs physical attention, aiding navigation but occasionally causing head-turning confusion.
A pattern where humans pause briefly before grasping items passed by robots, assessing stability and intent in physical exchanges.
A pattern where subtle vibrations amplify perceived body movements, altering gait or balance during active physical activities.
A pattern where shadows cast by hovering drones trigger instinctive dodging maneuvers among people below, disrupting normal locomotion.
A pattern where larger robots command greater clearance space during passages, with humans yielding paths more readily than they would to peers.
A pattern where rhythmic lighting changes in smart-rooms synchronize with movements, subtly guiding paths or signaling states physically.
A pattern where wearables deliver corrective pulses to maintain safe distances from obstacles, refining spatial awareness over time.
A pattern where delays in robot responses to human gestures during physical demos cause frustration and adjusted interaction pacing.
A pattern where propellers on drones generate localized winds that tousle hair or clothing, eliciting tactile surprise reactions.
A pattern where smart-room chairs reshaping under occupants provoke momentary imbalance, training adaptive seating postures.
A pattern where extended robotic limbs accessing high shelves prompt humans to step back, respecting augmented reach zones.
A pattern where gentle compressive haptics from wearables simulate reassuring touches, modulating arousal during physical exertion.
A pattern where steady drone positioning at eye level invites prolonged observation, fostering curiosity in stationary encounters.
A pattern where frequent smart-room proximity warnings lead to ignoring them, risking closer physical integrations over time.
A pattern where robots with fabric-like surfaces receive more tactile explorations, increasing physical interaction durations.
A pattern where smart-rooms clearing paths ahead align with human trajectories, creating fluid physical traversals through occupied space.
A pattern where wearables pulsing in sync with heart rhythm promote a sense of calm, influencing physical relaxation states.
A pattern where forward tilts by robots during talks reduce perceived distance, intensifying conversational physicality.
A pattern where collective hums from drone swarms blend into ambient sound, lessening auditory startle in physical underpasses.
A pattern where smart-rooms casting personalized light auras around individuals enhance spatial ownership feelings.
A pattern where robots matching human walking paces in tandem foster synchronized physical group dynamics.
A pattern where distinct vibration sequences from wearables convey messages, bypassing visual cues in low-light physical settings.
A pattern where drones at three to five meters height minimize ground disturbances, optimizing non-intrusive physical monitoring.
A pattern where robots warming contact surfaces to ambient levels ease physical handoffs and prolong interactions.
A pattern where smart-room partitions gliding silently reshape spaces, guiding physical groupings without verbal prompts.
A pattern where robots simulating breathing rhythms during close proximity evoke subconscious calming effects in nearby observers.
A pattern where dynamic mass redistribution in wearables stabilizes balance during rapid physical maneuvers.
A pattern where drones projecting floor markers direct physical routes, streamlining crowd movements in venues.
A pattern where smart-room floors pulsing underfoot provide directional cues, aiding navigation in low-visibility settings.
